# Maren Solberg

Maren Solberg is an instrument scientist. She is based at [[brask-station]]
and maintains the [[drift-buoy-db9]].

## Background

She speaks Norwegian and Portuguese and joined the institute in 2019.
Before that she built underwater sensors for a fisheries agency.
